reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, selects its categories through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and converts amounts with averageToBudget; the #fixed check reuses extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules live once in the shared selector; the only repetition is the optional includeHiddenCategories parameter threaded through five action signatures.

placement.why: Rules go into the bulk-category selector in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts next to the others with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Changes are limited to the four requested behaviours plus tests.

maintainability.why: One selector owns all exclusions; the compound boolean condition and inline JSON.parse of goal_def are slightly dense, and reusing averageToBudget for a non-average is a mild naming stretch.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories: includeHidden replaced by optional includeHiddenCategories; template and #fixed exclusions added as general rule conditions, not per-caller special cases.
